svg.aria-label: Small surface. Real agent.. Press Control+Space from the app you are in. Type, and your agent answers in the box. Your tools, not just chat. Null drives the Oh-my-pi harness it carries: its tools, your configured MCP servers, your approval mode. Your providers, one conversation. Switch models, read usage, keep an ordered fallback list. OMP owns the sign-ins and the retries. Readable without getting bigger. Streamed Markdown, folded tool steps, and code, tables and diagrams that scroll sideways instead of wrapping. Today: a standalone macOS text app with a small pet beside it, installed with one command. Voice, background tasks and workspaces are planned, not built. The banner above is an illustration, not a recording of an agent session.
